entries.t: <FACE:03>Wow! A huge mansion…<NL>Blocks like this too!
<FACE:05>Oh my?!<NL><WAIT>What a fancy mansion!<NL>Anyone living there?
<FACE:00>I don't think any…
<FACE:07>Even if not, we could<NL>at least rest a bit!
<FACE:00>We should hur…
<FACE:07>Right!<NL><WAIT>Let's take a break<NL>here, shall we!
<FACE:00>But we still…
<FACE:07><PLAYER><NL>I'll wait right here!<WAIT>Go check out the<NL>mansion, and hurry!
<FACE:0A><PLAYER>…<NL><WAIT>Got something you want<NL>to say?
<FACE:33>My, my, if it isn't…<NL><PLAYER> and…
<FACE:33>Miss Koharubi…<NL>And an unknown face<WAIT>What business brings<NL>you to our mansion?
<FACE:00>Ohh, so this mansion<NL>is yours?
<FACE:00>Ah, this is Fubuki<NL><WAIT>He goes to another<NL>school…<WAIT>Like us, he got left<NL>behind here too
<FACE:0A>Hey, hey, at least let<NL>me introduce mys…<WAIT><FACE:33>And so…? What is it<NL>you want of us?
<FACE:00>We want to see if this<NL>place is safe, so…

<FACE:06>(Hey! That mansion<NL> can't be theirs!)<WAIT>(I want to rest there<NL> too, so shoo them!)<WAIT><FACE:04>(But they're not the<NL> listening type…)<WAIT><FACE:06>(You're the president<NL> now, so order them!)
<FACE:00>I… sort of ended up<NL>the acting president<WAIT>This Block might be<NL>dangerous too…<WAIT>Leave this to us for<NL>now, and let us in?
<FACE:33>Ohhhhh ho ho ho ho ho!<WAIT><FACE:35>Oh ho ho ho ho!<WAIT><FACE:36>Hee hee hee
<FACE:33>Commoners such as you<NL><WAIT>may well dream of such<NL>a gorgeous mansion!<WAIT>But it hardly suits<NL>the likes of you!<WAIT>This mansion befits<NL>only people like us…<NL>
<FACE:33>Only truly gorgeous<NL>people belong here!<WAIT>Do look elsewhere!
<FACE:33>Ohhhh ho ho ho ho ho!
<FACE:06>(Gorgeous, my foot!<NL> Ohhh ho ho ho, ugh!)<WAIT>(That does it!<NL> I'm resting there!)
<FACE:09>I'm… sooooo tired…
<FACE:09>Might I rest a while<NL>in this mansion…?

<FACE:34>Oh, how unfortunate!<WAIT><FACE:33>But we are quite worn<NL>out ourselves too…<WAIT>We live so elegantly<NL>we tire more than you<WAIT>And sadly, we have no<NL>rooms to spare!<WAIT><FACE:09>Oh… that's rough…<NL>One room, as friends?<WAIT><FACE:34>Friends, you say?<WAIT><FACE:33>My… commoners become<NL>friends so easily!<WAIT>How I envy you!
<FACE:06>Snaaap!
<FACE:06>That does it!!<NL><WAIT>You're just rich kids!<NL><WAIT>The great <PLAYER><NL>will Robattle you!
<FACE:03>Ah! W-wait, Hiyo…!?
<FACE:34>My my… <PLAYER>?<WAIT><FACE:33>What a way to speak to<NL>the likes of us!<WAIT>Very well then<NL><WAIT>Do savor our gorgeous<NL>Medabots' power!
<FACE:06>Now hand over this<NL>Block without a fuss!
<FACE:03>(Hiyori, that's just<NL> blackmail…)
<FACE:33>My, we accepted, yes<NL><WAIT>but when did we stake<NL>this mansion on it?<WAIT>What a wild accusation<NL><WAIT><FACE:34>Oh, how scary!
<FACE:35>My, how scary!
<FACE:36>So scary…
<FACE:04>Hm?
<FACE:06>What do you mean,<NL>scary?!<WAIT><FACE:33><PLAYER>?<NL><WAIT>Which way are you<NL>facing as you speak?
<FACE:04>Hey, um…
<FACE:06>(What is it, <PLAYER>!<NL> Don't look away!)<WAIT>(I'm dealing with this<NL> blockhead now…)<WAIT><FACE:04>I keep hearing a sound<NL>I recognize…
<FACE:64>Intruder detected<NL>Disposing of intruder<WAIT>Intruder detected<NL>Disposing of intruder<WAIT>Disposing of intruder<WAIT><FACE:64>Disposing
<FACE:34>W-wait a moment…<NL>What in the world…
<FACE:01>I knew it…<WAIT><FACE:05>So the Medabots here<NL>turn on humans too…<WAIT>That Shiden guy<NL><WAIT>seems to control every<NL>Cluster Medabot…
<FACE:01>But dispose of us…<NL>how?<WAIT><FACE:64>We will crush you in a<NL>Robattle

<FACE:34>My, disposing of us…<WAIT><FACE:33>This place belongs to<NL>us and no one else!<WAIT><PLAYER>!<NL><WAIT>If you are president,<NL>then fight for us!<WAIT>Do that and we may let<NL>you use this Block!
<FACE:0A>Can't be helped, huh,<NL><PLAYER>…<WAIT><FACE:0B>We have to take this<NL>place anyway
<FACE:07>Ooh! How wonderful!<NL><WAIT>That's our president,<NL><PLAYER>!
<FACE:05>Right! As promised,<NL>I'll be resting here
<FACE:05><PLAYER>, you should<NL>rest a bit too…
<FACE:01>No, Hiyori!<NL><WAIT>If Shiden controls the<NL>Cluster's Medabots,<WAIT>we've gotta find our<NL>classmates fast!
<FACE:08>H-hey, <PLAYER>!<NL>Wait up!
<FACE:05><PLAYER>, hurry and go<NL>take a look
<FACE:0C>Pretty fancy, huh<NL>That mansion
<FACE:33>Megumi joined the<NL>team!<WAIT><FACE:35>Shizuku joined the<NL>team!<WAIT><FACE:36>Sachi joined the team!
